narration.say: On November 14th, China's electric airliner flew its first crew.
Jet fuel packs about fifty times more energy per kilo than batteries.

narration.say: Electric motors waste less, winning back only about twice.
And a battery never gets lighter, while fuel burns off.

shots.beat: first frame / hook: generic paper 19-seat airliner with ten wing-top fans, in flight above clouds + "Ten fans. No jet fuel."
the flight: the airliner over patchwork fields; source chip
question: a 400 km ring grows on a schematic map
first principles: one kilo of jet fuel stacks ~50 energy tiles; one kilo of battery pack, one
efficiency: half the fuel tiles burn off as waste heat — still ~25x
weight: on two scales, the fuel block shrinks during the flight, the battery block stays
payoff: short hops inside the ring; a small airliner flies one
CTA: Media Diet sign under the airliner
